projection_record.slot_basis: Sylvester Hadamard64; no slot permutation; row0 mean is implicit
projection_record.slot_weight_scale: each coefficient +/-1/64, same row norm as mean weights
projection_record.channel_basis: float64 Gaussian384x48 reduced QR, positive diagonal R; cast float32
projection_record.residual_extraction: FP32: center z by its slot mean, apply slot weights then shared channel projection
projection_record.residual_storage: float32 raw contrasts, shape(window,patch,336); no normalization in extraction
projection_record.normalization: M is historical FP32 torch LayerNorm(mean_FP16); residuals divided by sqrt(var_feature(mean_FP16_FP32)+eps); no separate residual LayerNorm, PCA or scaler
projection_record.M48_control: normalized mean projected to the same 48 channels; no residual modes
projection_record.S384_order: mean@channel_projection, residual slot modes in frozen row order
projection_record.S720_order: full normalized mean, residual slot modes in frozen row order

mean_parity_gate.support: every real patch; never filtered by target mask
